target_customer: Independent bands that want to communicate with fans and plan tours
problem: Bands lack tools to reach fans and decide where to tour based on fan demand.
business_model: Web based applications for bands; pricing not found
product_category: Band to fan communication and tour planning tools

founders.name: Altay Guvench
founders.background_notes: Named as the 2006 founder on the YC page. No background found.

founders.name: Ben Silbermann
founders.background_notes: The YC company page lists him as a founder with Audiobeta 2006 to 2008 among his roles; no second source found, see notes.

technical_complexity.rationale: Web apps for band communication and tour planning; standard 2006 web development.

defensibility.rationale: Mailing and tour tools were easy to copy and MySpace was where bands already talked to fans.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: MySpace and later artist tools such as ReverbNation absorbed band to fan communication; no source says what happened to Audiobeta.

market_need_then: 2006 commentary reported that bands got more fan email through MySpace pages than their own sites, showing demand for fan communication, though none of it mentions Audiobeta.

branding.domain_note: audiobeta.com redirects to a domain marketplace listing (atom.com) as of this research.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found.

outcome_analysis: Audiobeta built web tools to help bands talk to fans and plan tours and was in YC Winter 2006. The company is listed Inactive, the website now redirects to a domain sale page, and no article, post mortem or founder statement about its end or funding was found, so the cause of failure is not public in the sources checked.
notes: Competitors: no dated sources naming Audiobeta rivals found, so the list is empty. CB Insights lists a seed round with Y Combinator as investor but no date or amount in the snippet, so no round is recorded. The YC page lists Ben Silbermann as a founder with Audiobeta in his role history; this is unverified by a second source and team size on the YC page is 0. Outcome cause not public.
